title: [Refurb] Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones (Seconds) $223.20 Delivered (Excl. WA, TAS, NT) @ Sony eBay
body:
Deal: [Refurb] Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones (Seconds) $223.20 Delivered (Excl. WA, TAS, NT) @ Sony eBay

[clartan2015] For those looking for new one, its $299 now at costco - https://www.costco.com.au/c/Sony-Wireless-Noise-Cancelling-H…
[clartan2015] Ahh yeah. I did a quick google and seems their difference is non-SA comes with hard case and other with soft
[jihape] Came up as 200.88 for me. Ill try them out for that price.
[Cheeky Chelsea] did you do anything special for the extra money off?
[SoTightEcoLPI] Wow that's a good price. I'm still rocking XM3. HODL in this economy.
[Drakesy] My XM3 was doing so well - then the hinge disintegrated.
[justtoreply] Certified refurbished is actually refurbished isn't it?
Whereas box damage is often new.
[NoCodeMonkey] Sony WH-1000XM6 box damaged AU are $499.00 and with the extra 20% off code (SONYCLEARANCE) they are AU $99.80 off so Total AU $399.20. 9 available 13 sold. It says "AS NEW: This item may have damaged carton. It is an unused & undamaged item in its original packaging."
[justtoreply] I'm not after XM6 at $400, I'm after something for my kids so XM5 at $223 is much better. However, $223 is tolerable for box damaged but I don't wish to pay that for actual refurbished.
[Crimzic] I wouldn't give XM5s to my kids - hinges are too fragile.
[NoCodeMonkey] @Crimzic: I loved my XM4. Replace the hinge a few times but that is due to rough treatment. Only reason for my buying the XM6 is I have misplaced my 4's and sub 400 seems reasonable.
[justtoreply] @Crimzic: I'm struggling to buy anything cheaper that's not total garbage in terms of how it fits or whether the ANC is effective
[Kangal] XM5 vs XM6 ….what are the improvements (or downgrades) ?
[kerfuffle] Improvement: the XM6 actually can fold unlike the XM5
[ddoraaaaa] @kerfuffle: correction: the xm5 can, and usually do, fold once during its lifecycle
[cheesecactus] Perth Metro excluded, is that new? Or have I just not noted that before
[Pigey] Wow. Was looking to get a pair but also got denied to Perth
[viirgon] Not new. Have seen for previous eBay deals.
[cerealsmok3r] Good price but I’d skip this if you want foldable ones. Xm4 had it and they brought it back for xm6
[gviddy] Just don't, at any price these are a waste of your money. XM4's are better than these. These headphones were Sony's Windows 8 moment.
[alumunum] I forgot that these don't fold up nice. Which is a reason I avoided them. Then found out the plastic bits break, and I am not sure the microphone quality for calls is too good (Might be wrong about this but none of the reviews said they were better than predecessors)
[alumunum] (I wrote this before realizing this post is about xm5s, but I think my experience of still happily wearing xm3s and xm4s when 6s aren't around might give people perspective)
I have xm2, 3, 4, 6. Really happy with the quality of 6. The phone calls are clear, I've never had the person on the other end complain about not hearing me. But I wear them all day and eventually sweat started condensing inside the cups and after a few hours of wear, the condensation starts triggering the touch controls in long sequences of touch control presses and renders them unusable. Disabling touch controls in software didn't do anything to stop it. Even if the connected device doesn't receive them, they still beep beep beep and interrupt the audio. Just sent them off to sony for repair. Will see how they go. I still use xm3s and other than the plastic parts on the bottom of the band breaking (Zipties provide structural integrity for them to still be comfortable.
XM4s have been perfect. But are primarily my wife's and she is a much lighter user. (Just work hours mon - friday) But honestly I don't feel like I am getting too much more with the xm6s than I do with 3s or 4s. (Other than aforementioned great microphone quality for calls) The low latency mode might be worth it for gaming. But I haven't played anything multiplayer that needed the lower latency stuff since I got them. So hard to comment if they can replace wireless gaming headsets.
It might be worth noting that on xm6s the noise cancelling might be slightly tooo good. The previous versions I can hear people talking to me, it just blocks out noise. XM6s block out when my wife talks directly to me. She thinks it's a problem. I am kinda ok with it. But maybe that's too much.
Multi device connection on xm6 is also great. But sometimes i'll be upstairs and some shitty tab is playing silent audio to keep the tab from going to sleep (thing aliexpress was doing till recently) and you can't get the device you are upstairs with to play anything because there is still something "Playing"
And I should also note xm2s are on thier fourth sets of ear pads. Got them in 2018 and wore them every day. The battery started going iffy last year. Still ok to use when I can coax the battery to charge. And I would be using them more.
The issue XM6s that has just sent them for warranty repair was condensation getting inside the "sealed" cavity and triggering controls. AI said it was a common issue, and it has been very persistent. I think the cups are a more robust plastic rather than that thin soft pleather that every previous model I have (Which eventually crumbles) But if I google xm6 issue I get a lot of borken plastic clips with complaints that sony makes you pay for the repair as it is "user misuse" xm5 also suffer fro the cracking parts, and much worse than the xm6. If that ever comes up for me, I am sending them photos of my xm2s that were worn pretty much continuously for 8 years and getting ombudsman involved.
[DrScavenger] XM6s block out when my wife talks directly to me. She thinks it's a problem. I am kinda ok with it.
I lol'd. Also how are these compared to airpods pro?
[alumunum] Like apples and potatoes. Different class of device. Unless you mean airpods max? Which I've never had. But I had airpods pro 2… Till I dropped it in the drain when I went to pat a cute dog. My main buds are samsung galaxy buds 3 pro. Go to device for making phone calls. I haven't compared the sound quality for phone calls, but never had the other side complain about sound quality with galaxy buts or xm5s? So that's the only point of comparison I can offer.
[hypie] Managed to grab the last pair of black box damaged 1000XM6's off ebay for $399!
Pretty happy with that and the TRS claim on top.
